frequency_question: How often is a 0% active buffer raised above zero within a two-year observation period?
membership_rule: Members are G20 central banks with operational CCyB frameworks. Excluded are countries without active framework monitoring or where data is missing.
coverage_note: 10 named cases representing major advanced economy central bank cycles; believed roughly 25 comparable windows globally.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market jurisdictions with less standardized institutional frameworks.
skeleton: 10 named historical windows across comparable jurisdictions
multiplier: 1x direct enumeration of major peer central bank windows
validity_reason: Macroprudential governance frameworks and institutional inertia evolve slowly over multi-year horizons.
